title: High-Pressure Sodium
body:

# High-Pressure Sodium

| Approx. pressure | State                                                  |
| ---------------: | ------------------------------------------------------ |
|            low P | bcc metal                                              |
|          ~65 GPa | fcc                                                    |
|         ~103 GPa | cI16                                                   |
|     ~118–119 GPa | oP8                                                    |
|         ~125 GPa | tI19                                                   |
|         ~200 GPa | hP4 transparent insulator                              |
|          223 GPa | interstitial electron density experimentally supported |
|       to 310 GPa | hP4 retained in 2025 study                             |
